name: D17 prospective versioned event ledger

timeRules.replayEligibility: A version is visible only if firstKnownAt<=replayAsOf and capturedAt<=replayAsOf under the selected conservative clock contract.
timeRules.corrections: Corrections and updates append new versions. Earlier records are never overwritten.
timeRules.missingTimestamp: UNKNOWN; never infer from crawl order or later timestamps.
timeRules.sourceTimeVsCaptureTime: Preserve both; capture time is a conservative upper bound when source publication time cannot be independently authenticated.

dedupRules: Exact or near-exact syndication with no incremental fact remains one event cluster.
A materially new numeric, timing, customer, regulatory, capacity, guidance or economic fact is UPDATE, not duplicate.
Similar text with different event date/object is not merged solely by embedding similarity.
Future versions may extend cluster membership but cannot alter historical replay state before their firstKnownAt.

coverageReceipt.rule: Absence may support NO_KNOWN_EVENT only when source poll coverage/completeness is proven for the relevant lane; otherwise absence is UNKNOWN.

opensOnlyAfter: entity/event mapping is frozen without outcome inspection
event class and horizons are preregistered
market/sector/peer controls and corporate-action firewall are defined

architecture.preference: isolated research storage, no Formal dependency
architecture.providerCalls: Do not add latency-sensitive production calls under this design.
architecture.system1: Research observer only; current Formal unchanged.
architecture.system2: Candidate future L5 research data source only after source/license/PIT gates pass.
